objective: Optimize context packing while preserving source and warning metadata — an additive, advisory best-effort packer that recovers budget wasted by the baseline apply_context_budget (which breaks at the first overflowing item).

summary.migrator_change: None — read-only advisory report with NO DB writes at all. Schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.authoritative_packer: apply_context_budget (retrieval/policy.py) is NOT modified (consumed by broker.py 2x, hybrid_broker.py, asserted in test_retrieval_policy.py). The optimizer is additive; broker adoption is deferred.

design.problem: apply_context_budget fills in priority order (tier -> recency -> confidence -> source_ref) but breaks at the first item that would overflow; with per-item excerpts capped at max_item_chars=1800 inside a max_context_chars=24000 budget, the cumulative sum can stop with hundreds of chars free while a small lower-priority item that would fit is silently dropped.
design.optimize_context_packing: Same ordering + same max_item_chars truncation, but best-effort fill: skip an oversized item and continue. Never exceeds max_context_chars; every kept item retains full metadata; every drop surfaced as budget_dropped:<family> + budget_dropped_tier{N}:<family> coverage warnings (no silent loss).
design.build_path: Mirrors the broker's pre-budget gather (allowlist; excluded/unknown/no-reader denied with coverage warnings), then reports a metadata-only baseline-vs-optimized comparison. read_only=True, assembles_final_answer=False, persists nothing (no DB writes).
design.doctrine: Advisory leaf — assembles_final_answer=false; never exceeds the budget; never drops without a coverage warning; preserves review tier / confidence / source refs / freshness / coverage warnings; the authoritative packer is unchanged.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: On the real operator corpus the optimizer recovered 4 source-linked items the baseline break-at-overflow dropped, without exceeding the budget and preserving all metadata. The build performs no DB writes.
